caption: Jesus explicitly applies Psalm 8 to children praising him. The link is strong—but Matthew uses a present description of God’s glory, in its Greek form, for a new scene.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did Psalm 8 predict children praising Jesus? Children praise Jesus in the temple. When critics complain, Jesus answers by quoting Psalm 8.
slides.body: Children praise Jesus in the temple. When critics complain, Jesus answers by quoting Psalm 8.
slides.heading: Did Psalm 8 predict children praising Jesus?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Ps 8:2: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise.

slides.alt_text: The claimed New Testament fulfilment in Matt 21:16, BSB: “Do You hear what these children are saying?” they asked. “Yes,” Jesus answered. “Have you never read: ‘From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise’?”

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: The connection is explicit The children, their praise and the hostile audience all fit the verse. Jesus himself makes the link.
